LXX at 52579 has its own marked synopsis 52581-52585, addressee/selfprotocol 52587-52594, full exordium and ordered paragraphs 1-4 granting the mandate concerning Venetian censures and interdict, and complete dating 52786-52788/editorial dating 52790. Exclude 52605-52611: historical note 1 at 52605-52610 describes the Ostia/Velletri faculties and is keyed to marker 1 in the preceding act's dating at 52575. Retain source note 2 at 52612 keyed to current synopsis marker 52585, the historical letter-absence note 52671-52672 keyed to 52657, and readings/source apparatus 52778 and 52780-52781 keyed to 52734 and 52766. Quoted or recited previous letters remain within the complete outer papal mandate. Stop before detached Cassinese marginal lines 52793-52795 belonging to the next LXXI at 52798.
